title: Fellowship to the 2027 Global Investigative Journalism Conference
about: GIJN fellowships for journalists to attend the 15th Global Investigative Journalism Conference (GIJC27), co-hosted by GIJN and the Dutch-Flemish Association of Investigative Journalists (VVOJ) in the Netherlands. Partial fellowships may also be offered.
requirements: Application must be submitted in English
card_alt: Card for the Fellowship to the 2027 Global Investigative Journalism Conference from the Global Investigative Journalism Network (GIJN), Rotterdam, Netherlands, deadline 31 Jan 2027. The photo shows colourful gabled canal houses and houseboats on a canal in Amsterdam, a different city from the offer.
